lines.meet: My name's Tarek. Tell me plainly where you need me and I'll be there, and if I stop at a stream, I'm only checking the water.
lines.meet_neighbour: We're neighbours at Splintertree, I think. I'm in the hut by the east spring. Tarek, and have you eaten?
lines.ask_home: Have you eaten today? Then sit, and tell me where home is.
lines.ask_work: What work did you do, before? I can usually guess from the hands, but tell me.
lines.answer_home: Cairo, a flat in Heliopolis I could still draw from memory, and then three years in Berlin.
lines.answer_work: Civil engineer, fourteen years, all of it water. Pumps, pressure, pipes, and nobody thanks you until the tap runs dry.
lines.chat_food: Koshari from a cart in Cairo, everything in one bowl, with the hot sauce. It's the best cheap meal in the world.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep when the wells are working. When one fails, I lie awake drawing it in my head.
lines.chat_missing: The Nile at night from a bridge, with the city lights on the water. I didn't know I'd miss it until I left.
lines.chat_here: Whatever's poisoning the water here is something I can see and fight. I never had that before, and it's been good for me.
lines.tease_quiet: The pressure gauge would love you, {name}. You'd watch it all day and never complain.
lines.tease_talker: Like a burst pipe, {name}, that's how you talk, everything at once and all over the floor.
lines.tease_careful: You check things as often as I check water, {name}, and that's saying something.
lines.tease_bold: You'd drink from any stream without asking, {name}. Please let me check it first.
lines.tease_any: Have you eaten, {name}? You always look like you haven't, and it worries me.
lines.tease_back: Ha, fair, {name}. I walked straight into that one.
lines.take_it_kindly: You're right, and I'll say so plainly.
lines.bristle: Plainly, {name}, I don't like that one, so leave it.
lines.apologise: I was unkind just then, and I'm sorry. Plainly, I was wrong.
lines.double_down: Every word was meant, and I'd rather be honest with you than comfortable.
lines.needle_quiet: If you know something's wrong, tell me plainly. Guessing is how wells fail.
lines.needle_talker: Please, less talking, more checking. The water doesn't care what we say about it.
lines.needle_careful: You've measured it three times, and it hasn't changed. Build the thing.
lines.needle_bold: You're sure you're right, and you won't explain why. People like that wrecked my life once.
lines.needle_any: You waste things, water, food, time. I can't watch it without saying something.
lines.bite_back: Every cup of water this party has drunk, I checked first. Think about that before you call me careless.
lines.hurt: Okay, that was hard to hear. I'll be at the spring for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Contractors in Cairo were ruder over a single pipe. I'm still standing.
lines.confide: {name}, I had to leave Cairo inside a week because of who I loved. He told me to go, and that was the last time we spoke.
lines.listen: Sit down, {name}, I'll make tea. Then tell me plainly, and I'll listen plainly.
lines.look_out: Keep within reach, {name}, and don't drink anything in there.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, you've convinced me. I'll go along with it.
lines.deflect: Only a cut, {name}. Have you eaten? Eat first, then worry about me.
lines.check_in: Sit, {name}, and drink this first. Then show me the damage.
lines.blame: Somebody was sure they were right in there and didn't explain. That's how people get hurt.
lines.thank: Thank you, plainly. I owe you a meal, and I always pay.
lines.brush_off: No need, it's done. Drink some water, I've checked it.
lines.worry: Sit down, {name}, drink this, slowly. That was a bad fall.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's with me now, then. I'll keep it working, I'm good at keeping things working.
lines.hand_fine: Use it, it's wasted sitting with me. Waste is the only thing I mind.
lines.hand_sulk: Next time, ask me plainly, and the answer's probably yes.
lines.turn_friendly: You're welcome at my spring any time, {name}, and there'll be food.
lines.turn_friends: I'd draw you every well I've sunk, {name}, and why the one failed, and you'd let me finish.
lines.turn_grating: Plainly, it isn't working between us, and I'd rather say it than pretend.
lines.turn_rivals: You'll still drink clean water, because I check it for everybody. That's not about you.
lines.make_up: This is waste, {name}, and I hate waste. Let's fix it.
lines.defend: Plainly, that isn't true. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The spring's quiet without {name}, and I've had nobody to explain the wells to.
lines.friend_back: Have you eaten, {name}? Sit, you've come a long way.
lines.common_engineers: You think like an engineer, I've seen you look at a bridge. People like us can't walk past a failure without working out why.
lines.common_arabic: Arabic, {habibi|habibti}, what a gift! Where's your family from?
